description: PROP-I1 (REQ-I1) explicitly mandates 'Static grep over the dispatcher SHALL find 0 hits' for forbidden patterns {tmux kill, --stop, --kill}. An automated grep-test exists for skills/earn/gig/run.sh (skills/_shared/__tests__/test_gig_run_shim_no_human_touch.py:36-42) but NO automated grep-test asserts this invariant against skills/_shared/proactive-loop-dispatch.py. Manual grep currently finds 0 hits, so the code is correct today — but the regression guard the verification architecture demands is missing. A future edit to the dispatcher (e.g. adding an emergency 'tmux kill-server' helper) would silently bypass the invariant.
